$comment: Platform-neutral copies of the demo fixtures. Canonical sources: src/onboarding/slides.ts, src/demo/lessons.ts (DEMO_SAMPLE_FILES, DEMO_LESSONS). Lesson bodies/question banks are long; read them from lessons.ts.

introSlides.title: Welcome to ProofQuest
introSlides.body: Understand a topic, practice what you learn, and see your progress.

introSlides.title: Start studying in one step
introSlides.body: Tap or drag a sample document to open a lesson.
introSlides.note: Demo: built-in sample documents only. Your own files aren't opened or uploaded.

introSlides.title: Turn understanding into practice
introSlides.body: Preview questions and explore how practice works.
introSlides.note: Demo: question previews come from a fixed sample set, not AI.
